app.name: DizMatrix
app.tagline: Map your field. Know what's coming for it.

login.invalidCode: Invalid code. Please check and try again.
login.hint: Your code was provided by AgriFusion. Contact agrifusion-web.vercel.app for support.

map.instructions: Use the polygon tool on the map to trace your field boundary.
map.instructionsShort: Draw your field boundary to begin
map.editHint: Tap the polygon icon, then tap each corner of your field. Tap the first corner again, or use the Finish button, to close the shape.

empty.title: No field mapped yet
empty.body: Trace your farm's boundary on the map to see which diseases have been reported nearby and how much risk they pose to your crop.

results.heading: Risk assessment
results.noReports: No disease reports found within {{radius}} km of this field. That's good news — but keep scouting.
results.sourceNote: Assessment derived from crowd-reported field observations. Treat as guidance, not diagnosis.

errors.fetchFailed: Couldn't reach the report database. Check your connection and try again.
errors.polygonOnWater: Your field boundary appears to be drawn over water. No credit has been deducted — please clear the shape and redraw it over your actual farmland.
